records.topic: Demand whether threatened resurrection/judgment is true

records.topic: Would give all earthly possessions as ransom from judgment
records.assessment: A possible specific literary comparison is Psalm 49:7–9 (human wealth cannot ransom life); the Psalm's focus on mortality differs from the Qur'anic scene of judgment, regret and concealed remorse.
